title: WINDWAY — reveal trailer
source_description: User-supplied recording of the playable browser build; the original HUD is preserved.
adaptations: Only Alpine and Canopy gameplay appears in the supplied recording. No snow footage is fabricated.
The garage shows the selected Mercedes-AMG W14 in Trail orange; car and paint changes were not recorded.
Map selection, starting, pausing and returning to the garage are shown. Starter, Settings and Continue interactions were not recorded.
Wide gameplay is fitted inside the 16:9 export to retain the complete recorded HUD without stretching.
The hook uses the real recorded acceleration sound; no unrecorded ignition is implied.

shots.note: Close framing of the actual orange car rotating in the recorded garage; the source cursor is outside this crop.

shots.title: YOUR ROAD. YOUR PACE.
shots.note: Alpine acceleration, ramp and landing, beginning beyond the obstructing start arch.

shots.title: MAKE THE DRIVE YOURS.
shots.note: Real garage, car choices and paint swatches; navigation header excluded by framing.
Actual map selection from Canopy to Alpine.
Match the selected orange car to the same car accelerating on the road.
Jade river crossing, ending before the later collision.
Uninterrupted, normal-speed acceleration, ramp landing, checkpoint, river bridge and cornering. No title obscures the original HUD. Begins beyond the obstructing start arch.

shots.title: START. EXPLORE.
shots.note: Actual pause menu, framed more closely for readability.
Recorded return from pause to the garage.
Actual map page and start-drive button.
Cut from the real start-drive button to driving on the Alpine road; not an unrecorded Continue action.
Fast approach to the Alpine finish, cut before the results screen.
Prepared animated ending, video only. The full score is mixed once across the trailer.
